verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle inside its cream circle, but the circle is cropped against the top-left canvas edges. The subtitle is indented off the headline's left edge, and the NEW and Try It pills are stacked flush right, leaving the lower-left area empty. B breaks the product graphic: the cream circle has drifted to the right as an empty disc, and the orange bottle on the orange background turns into an almost invisible outline. B's buttons also lose the original pill shape, although its text and button row are cleaner.
